hypothesis: FreeBSD mounts root via /dev/vtbd0. The VirtIO-BLK backend completes the sector read synchronously and raises interrupt (isr_status|=1), but VMCS interrupt injection occurs ONLY on HLT exits. If the guest is not in HLT or if RTE11 is masked during early HLT, the interrupt is discarded and never re-injected, causing mountroot to hang indefinitely.
